label: Spend cap per run
help: An estimate Claude plans around, not a hard stop. Every skill stays under it.

label: Where pages go
help: How you read the pages Proofs builds.

label: Screenshot quality
help: Lower makes smaller pages, which load faster on a phone.

label: Screenshot widest size
help: Screenshots wider than this are scaled down.

label: Send to Claude wait
help: How long a page waits before it says Claude has not picked up your message.

label: Page size warning
help: Proofs warns when a page is bigger than this.

label: Spelling check
help: Flags British spellings in what the reader sees.

label: Smallest text
help: Can only go up from 16 px.

label: Smallest tap target
help: Can only go up from 44 px.

label: Extra capture widths
help: 390 and 1280 are always captured.

label: Design options per item
help: Fewer is cheaper, with less to choose from.

label: Who scores the options
help: Claude scoring its own work tends to pass it.

label: Correction passes
help: Rebuilds after the critic, at most.

label: Photo candidates per spot
help: photo-picker shows up to this many.

label: Mockups per visual-qa item
help: Suggested fixes shown for each problem.

label: Review-cycle checkpoint
help: Saves a handoff after this many items.

label: Dev-server port
help: The port Proofs starts your app on for screenshots.

label: Before-shot port
help: The port for the base copy of the app that pr-qa photographs for its before shot.

label: Server start timeout
help: How long to wait for the app to start answering.

label: Design profile file
help: Where design-review keeps what it learned about your site's look.

label: Style guide file
help: Where the style-guide skill records accepted rules.

label: Changelog folder
help: Where the changelog skill keeps its markdown files.

label: To-do file
help: The open-work list the todos skill reads.

label: To-do archive folder
help: Where finished to-dos are archived, one file per month.

label: To-do title length
help: Longest title shown on the to-do page.

label: PR reminder at session start
help: Lists open pull requests when a session begins.

label: Agent branch prefix
help: Pull requests on branches starting with this are labeled as AI-agent work. Separate several with commas.

label: PR reminder network wait
help: How long the reminder waits for GitHub before giving up.

label: pr-qa visual paths
help: A pull request touching these paths counts as a visible change. Separate with commas.

label: pr-qa workflow file
help: The GitHub workflow file pr-qa looks for.

label: pr-qa page map file
help: Maps changed files to the pages to photograph.

label: Browser
help: Which browser takes screenshots. Auto uses the bundled one, then Chrome.

label: Playwright folder
help: Where Playwright is installed. Auto checks the project, then the Proofs cache.

label: pr-qa base folder
help: Where pr-qa checks out the base branch for its before shot.
